outcome.stat_test: Friedman tests (reject H0 at alpha=5% for all measure/classifier pairs); paired Wilcoxon tests vs each baseline (Table 4, p.16, printed 5198)

win_claim.quote: The experimental evaluation demonstrated that the proposed method achieves better results in terms of G-mean, balanced accuracy, macro-AP, MCC and F-score than other related methods.

uncertain: Table 1 (p.12) prints per-class cardinalities only; n_instances, n_features, n_classes, IR per dataset are not printed, so set null (not computed).
Plain SMOTE is not a baseline; smote values null. Static-SMOTE and K-means-SMOTE columns are in rows' source Table 2 only via best_other (not separated).
Chosen metric is balanced accuracy because Table 2 is the only per-dataset table in the paper; G-mean/AP/F/MCC per-dataset and other classifiers are in online appendix (not in paper), see notes.
Bold/underline marks in Table 2 are not visible in text extraction (p.14); marks field left generic; Table 2 not rendered visually.
best_other_* is the max printed value among the 10 baselines in Table 2 (ties joined with '/'); not a winner decision.

how_obtained 'modified' for real datasets: authors chose minority/majority class categorisation via SOUP paper (p.11); Cleveland_2 merges classes 0+1; whether data were otherwise used as distributed is not stated.
Source repo UCI for real datasets from 'Availability of data' statement (p.19); individual dataset-to-UCI mapping (e.g. Wine quality, Contraceptive) not itemised.
notes: Proposed method: GMMSampling (Naglik & Lango, Machine Learning 2024, 113:5183-5202). Ablation variants in Table 5 (p.17): without GMM, without undersampling, without Q_k, without P(x|k); Table 5 uses decision tree + G-mean (avg G-mean full method 0.6689). Per-dataset results for other classifiers and measures are in the online appendix at https://www.cs.put.poznan.pl/mlango/publications/GMMSampling.html (as printed, footnote 3, p.13) - not fetched. Table 3 (p.15) gives average ranks (DT, G-mean: Ours 2.33; S-SM 5.53; KM-SM 6.87). Implementation submitted to multi-imbalance library (https://github.com/damian-horna/multi-imbalance, as printed). Table 2 Average row printed: Ours 0.677; S-SM 0.646; KM-SM 0.632.
